title: Scenario 2: Reduced Redundancy & Availability Risk
description: Kubernetes manifest changes replicas from 3 to 1 and slashes CPU limits.

changed_files.patch:
@@ -8,12 +8,10 @@ spec:
-  replicas: 3
+  replicas: 1
   template:
     spec:
       containers:
         - name: app
-          resources:
-            limits:
-              cpu: "1000m"
-              memory: "2Gi"
+          resources:
+            limits:
+              cpu: "100m"
+              memory: "256Mi"
